quarterly_data.signal: Analog Devices' 10-K XBRL customer concentration shows unnamed distributors above 10% of revenue: Distributor 1 accounted for 24% of revenue in the fiscal period 2024-11-03 to 2025-11-01 (24% in 2023-10-29 to 2024-11-02, 25% in 2022-10-30 to 2023-10-28); Distributor 3 13% in 2024-11-03 to 2025-11-01 (12% in 2023-10-29 to 2024-11-02); Distributor 2 12% in 2023-10-29 to 2024-11-02 (10% in 2022-10-30 to 2023-10-28). No other customer accounted for greater than 10% of total revenue in any period presented.
XBRL segment revenue in the 10-K: ADI's Communications segment revenue was $1.38B in the fiscal year 2024-11-03 to 2025-11-01, up 26.2% YoY from $1.09B (period ending 2024-11-02).
